confidence_notes: I ran two web searches. One found the RBA rate. The other found crowd-sourced Wellington prices from mylifeelsewhere.com for a basic meal (about NZ$26), a domestic beer (about NZ$12-13), and a cappuccino (about NZ$6). That search found no cocktail or wine prices, so I estimated both from the beer price: cocktail at roughly 1.8x beer and a glass of wine at roughly 1.1x beer. The mid-range meal for two is also an estimate. I converted NZD prices to USD using an assumed NZD/USD rate of about 0.58. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from listings, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Wellington's own crowd-sourced price data, cross-checked against Auckland and Australian city price levels.
